rules.rationale: Android 16 imports SetProperty and sets bst.config.mountsf to 1 at the same VolumeManager::start phase as A13, before internal emulated-volume setup. AOSP16 lacks this A13-only requirement, so the explicit target port is necessary.
rules.necessity: Required to signal host/shared-folder mounting readiness for the guest integration path.
rules.performance: One property write during vold startup; no steady-state I/O cost.
rules.security: The property can activate a host-file sharing surface. SELinux property ownership and the consumer's path validation must prevent untrusted apps from spoofing or widening mounts.
validation_evidence: A13 and Android-16 VolumeManager::start contain the same property write; target commit a19a66ff changes only this startup signal. Runtime shared-folder regression remains in the final boot gate.

rules.rationale: A13 bypasses SetQuotaInherit and SetQuotaProjectId because App Player storage returns EOPNOTSUPP for project-quota ioctls. Android 16 preserves the exact success semantics with explicit no-op functions and removes the unreachable #if 0 blocks. AOSP16 lacks this A13-only workaround.
rules.necessity: Required so app-directory preparation does not fail on the virtual storage transport when project quotas are unavailable.
rules.performance: Avoids open and ioctl calls during app-directory creation and fixup, improving this path. It also disables project-quota accounting for the affected filesystem.
rules.security: Quota project IDs are not enforced by this layer, so storage isolation and abuse limits must come from the App Player storage backend and other Android controls. The no-op must remain scoped to this product tree.
validation_evidence: Android-16 SetQuotaInherit and SetQuotaProjectId explicitly return 0 with parameter suppression; target commit bf57a99 changes only Utils.cpp for this behavior. Full storage/runtime regression remains pending.
